templates.title: Write tests
templates.summary: Add tests for a feature or file
templates.prompt:
Write automated tests for: {goal}

Find the project's existing test setup and follow its style. Cover the main behaviour and the important edge cases, then run the tests. Change only test code; if you find a real bug, describe it instead of changing app code.
templates.goalHint: What should be tested? e.g. the login form

templates.title: Fix this error
templates.summary: Paste an error or log and get a fix
templates.goalHint: Where did it happen? e.g. when I log in

templates.title: Review my PR
templates.summary: Get a plain-language review of changes
templates.prompt:
Review these changes: {goal} {input}

Don't change any files. List problems by how serious they are (bugs, security, missing tests, readability), in plain words, with the file and line, and suggest a fix for each.
templates.goalHint: Which changes? e.g. my branch, or a PR link

templates.title: Update dependencies
templates.summary: Safely update packages and check the build
templates.prompt:
Update this project's dependencies. {goal}

Prefer patch and minor updates; list major updates instead of applying them. Run the build and tests afterwards and fix anything the updates broke. Don't publish anything.
templates.goalHint: Anything specific? e.g. only the web app

templates.title: Explain this code
templates.summary: Understand a file or feature in plain words
templates.prompt: Explain {goal} in plain language for someone in their first year of programming: what it does, how the pieces fit together, and anything risky or surprising. Don't change any files.
templates.goalHint: Which code? e.g. src/auth or the payment flow

route.reason: Add a project folder first; Agoragentic is installed and good at making careful code changes.
